description: Configure, view, or remove webhook for watchlist event notifications. Events (default: all): watchlist.company_changed, watchlist.board_changed, watchlist.ownership_changed, watchlist.status_changed, watchlist.company_removed_from_registry, watchlist.financials_updated, watchlist.filing_overdue, watchlist.insolvency, watchlist.court_gazette, watchlist.secured_liabilities, watchlist.sanctions, watchlist.public_tenders, watchlist.public_aid, watchlist.licenses, watchlist.nfz, watchlist.trademarks, watchlist.job_offers.

action.description: Action: 'get' to view config, 'set' to configure, 'delete' to remove.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. Defaults to all available events.

url.description: HTTPS webhook endpoint URL (required for action=set).

name: set_webhook_url
title: Configure Webhook URL
